description: Verify a mortgage's monthly principal-and-interest payment in two stages: TVM annuity computation of the level payment (ART-327), then a session receipt aggregating the run's execution hashes (CRY-05). Pure time-value-of-money mathematics; no regulation applies.
name: mortgage-pi-verifier

steps.handoff: Produces pmt, the level monthly principal-and-interest payment via the closed-form annuity factor; rate_pct is the periodic (monthly) rate and nper the total payment count
Produces session_receipt_root, the Merkle root over the run's execution_hashes (final stage)

title: Mortgage P&I Verifier
